## 解題
1. 題目提到 factordb -> 用 [factordb](https://factordb.com/)  找 `N` 的大質因數分解
   ![[W7-2_factordb.png]]
   `68007518329867517` $\times$ `90215697872880364191805901911792521199`
2. RSA 解密：
   ```python
   from Crypto.Util.number import *

	C = 5914137716482965816731532854486015635745376493723860582
	E = 65537
	N = 6135345726731701331370022700779188907294926069083992883
	
	p = 68007518329867517
	q = 90215697872880364191805901911792521199
	
	phi = (p-1)*(q-1)
	D = pow(E, -1, phi)
	
	print(long_to_bytes(pow(C, D, N)))
   ```
3. flag = `ICED{S33ms_silly}`
